items.title: Reproduce post-DONE freshness drift without changing completed story semantics
items.context: Use existing B-a57f/B-22b0 observations and a focused smoke fixture to show an already DONE story can be marked evidence-freshness fail after later main material commits even though the story was valid at DONE time.
items.userSees: User sees a reproducible regression note: a DONE story with valid historical test evidence no longer fails freshness just because later main material commits exist.

happy.desc: A focused regression fixture creates a DONE story whose test evidence matches its recorded evidence head, then adds a later unrelated material commit; done_closure reports evidence-freshness pass for that DONE story.

edge.desc: The reproduction does not mutate completed production stories like B-a57f or B-22b0; it uses an isolated temp repo fixture.

adversarial.desc: The regression fails before the fix when DONE story freshness is compared against current HEAD materialHash.

verificationEvidence.note: done-preflight-smoke now creates an isolated DONE story snapshot, commits a later unrelated material change, and asserts evidence-freshness remains pass for the completed story.
The regression uses temporary git fixture roots; it does not mutate completed production stories B-a57f or B-22b0.

The new regression specifically protects against the previous current-HEAD materialHash comparison; under that old behavior the post-DONE later material commit would make the DONE evidence-freshness row fail.

items.title: Make DONE story freshness use the recorded evidence snapshot
items.context: Adjust the DONE oracle freshness row so phase=DONE stories compare test-evidence materialHash to the material tree at evidence.headHash, not current HEAD. Keep active non-DONE gates strict against current workspace HEAD/materialHash.
items.userSees: User sees done_closure preserve completed-story evidence freshness against the recorded DONE-time snapshot, while non-DONE stories still require fresh current evidence.

happy.desc: For story.phase=DONE, the DONE oracle compares test-evidence materialHash with the material tree at evidence.headHash and returns pass when they match.

edge.desc: For story.phase not DONE, the DONE oracle still uses current HEAD/materialHash freshness and blocks stale active evidence.

adversarial.desc: If the recorded evidence head cannot be resolved or its material tree does not match evidence.materialHash, DONE story freshness fails closed rather than silently passing.

verificationEvidence.note: done-oracle checks story.phase === DONE and compares evidence.materialHash to currentMaterialHash(root, evidence.headHash), producing pass when the recorded snapshot matches.
Smoke output includes active TEST evidence freshness coverage: a later material commit still makes active TEST evidence-freshness fail.
Smoke includes fail-closed DONE snapshot cases for uninspectable or mismatched recorded evidence snapshots.

items.title: Add regression coverage for post-DONE main movement
items.context: Add/extend smoke coverage proving done_closure for a DONE story stays non-blocking after later unrelated material commits, while active TEST evidence still goes stale when material files change.
items.userSees: User sees done-preflight-smoke pass with explicit coverage for post-DONE main movement and active TEST stale-evidence blocking.

happy.desc: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-preflight-smoke.js passes and includes a post-DONE main movement regression.

edge.desc: Regression coverage also proves active TEST evidence still fails freshness after material changes.

adversarial.desc: Smoke output and assertions do not claim Authority Server receipt completion or weaken Authority receipt paths.

verificationEvidence.note: done-preflight-smoke passed and prints the completed-story regression line: DONE evidence freshness PASS after later material commit.
done-preflight-smoke also asserts active TEST evidence freshness still fails after material changes, so pre-DONE strictness is preserved.
The fix and smoke only affect local DONE projection freshness; no Authority receipt, productionDone, fullAuthorityDone, or receiptVerified semantics are changed or claimed.

auditLog.reason: Regression fixture and evidence recorded: completed DONE story freshness uses isolated temp repo and does not mutate B-a57f/B-22b0.
